short_bio: Actor-turned-director of Lady Bird, Little Women and Barbie.
biography:
Greta Gerwig was born in Sacramento, California, and studied at Barnard College. She first worked with the director Noah Baumbach on Frances Ha (2012), which they co-wrote.

Lady Bird (2017), her first film as sole director, earned Oscar nominations for Best Picture and Best Director, and she followed it with Little Women (2019). With Baumbach she co-wrote Barbie (2023), which she directed and which took more than a billion dollars at the box office.

She was president of the jury at the 2024 Berlin International Film Festival.
